resources.string: Your phone\'s movies on your TV and other devices, over your home Wi-Fi.
QR code with the address to open on your TV or other device
Start it, then open the address on your TV, tablet or laptop. It keeps running with the screen off.
Open this on any device on the same Wi-Fi, or scan the code. Keep this phone charging for long movies.
Connect this phone to your home Wi-Fi first.
Choose at least one folder below first.
This phone may stop HOMEFLIX in the background to save battery, which cuts off the TV mid-movie. Let it run unrestricted: tap below, find HOMEFLIX and choose Don\'t optimise (or Unrestricted).
Off: anyone on this Wi-Fi can watch. Keep it on when you\'re not at home.

Tick only the folders with your movies. Nothing is shared until you do, and only the ticked folders themselves, not folders inside them.\n\nFolders marked (personal) hold camera, chat or social-app videos: anyone with the PIN on your Wi-Fi could watch them.

Converted copies use %1$s of the limit. They\'re deleted when the server stops, and the oldest go first when the limit is reached.

Off: devices that can\'t play a movie\'s video format (often x265 on older TVs) can\'t watch it from this phone. On: the phone\'s video chip converts it while you watch. That warms the phone and uses more battery, so keep it charging; converting pauses by itself if the phone gets hot.
